name: a 40% refund of a fully paid invoice produces a proportional NEGATIVE delta, not a full reversal

expected.workings: Five consultations at 50000 were billed and paid in full: SIGMA deltas so far = percentAmount(250000, 1000) = 25000. Two of the five are then credited (40%) and the 100000 refund voucher is PAID. eligibleBase = 250000 - 100000 = 150000. settleable = 250000 - 100000 = 150000. collected = 250000 - 100000 = 150000. targetBase = divHalfUp(150000 x 150000, 150000) = 150000. target = percentAmount(150000, 1000) = divHalfUp(150000000, 10000) = floor(300010000 / 20000) = 15000, which is 60% of 25000 -- exactly the share of the sale that survived. delta = 15000 - 25000 = -10000. An implementation that reversed the FULL accrual on any refund would append -25000 and leave the ledger at 0.
